Subject: Kickoff: prompt regression + on-call playbook for QMon integration

Hi Sean / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We’re excited to get Quality Monitoring (QMon) wired into our deployment. A couple of priorities from our side:
- Ship an initial prompt set for baseline evaluation (covering clinical-rewrite, triage-summaries, and safety-guards)
- Integrate the eval harness into our CI so regressions block canary rollouts
- Define a light on-call playbook for prompt regression alerts and a clear rollback path

I attached the initial prompt CSV we discussed. Can we schedule a short run-through next week to align on responsibilities and timings?

High-level availability: I can do Tue/Wed morning (PT).

Thanks,
Taylor
Senior Product Manager, Greenleaf Health

Quick notes from my side before Wed:
- Prompt set looks well-scoped. I’ll convert Taylor’s CSV into our eval-suite format and surface initial metrics (accuracy proxies, hallucination flags, safety hits).
- Suggested guardrails to include in the first canary: token-level thresholds, safety-filter fail-rate, and a small manual review sample every 2500 responses.
- For alerts: we should classify signals as P0 (blocking rollout), P1 (needs attention, can continue), P2 (informational). P0 should trigger immediate rollback automation.

Action item I’ll take: upload eval harness README and a mapped prompt-to-eval matrix to the Drive by EOD Tue.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachment: eval_harness_integration_notes.md (text/markdown)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor@greenleaf.ai>
Date: 2028-09-13T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: prompt regression + on-call playbook for QMon integration

Technical checklist I propose (short):
- Eval harness integration: add a Jenkins job that runs the eval-suite against the canary model image post-deploy. If any P0 signal fires, the job fails.
- Signal plumbing: push alert events to Greenleaf’s PagerDuty via webhook; Redwood will send a signed JSON payload including signal id, metric, and suggested action.
- Canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% (with 30m monitoring windows). Manual approval required to proceed beyond 50% if any new prompt patterns detected.
- Rollback automation: a failed Jenkins job or explicit P0 alert will trigger the Redwood fallback to previous pinned model version (we keep the last stable pinned for 72h).

Open question for Taylor: do you want on-call rotations hosted by Greenleaf or do you prefer Redwood to be primary contact for the first 30 days?

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@greenleaf.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: prompt regression + on-call playbook for QMon integration

Thanks all — Wed sync was really helpful. Confirming next steps and owners: 
- Marissa: upload converted eval suite + initial metric dashboard (Due: 2028-09-18)
- Karthik: Jenkins job + PagerDuty webhook stub + rollback playbook (Due: 2028-09-20)
- Sean: drafted on-call playbook and runbook; will circulate v1 by EOD Mon.

Decision on on-call: Greenleaf will run primary on-call for product-impact P1/P2. For P0 (production-blocking regressions) Redwood will be primary to execute immediate rollback and investigate with Greenleaf. We’ll revisit ownership after 30 days.

We plan to start a 5% canary on 2028-09-25. Please confirm if that date works for Redwood.

Taylor
Senior Product Manager, Greenleaf Health
